page.notes: The bottom of the page is damaged by stains; the last line is partly obscured. "lu῾bentiffime" is a doubtful reading of "lubentissime" (the letter before "bentiffime" is unclear) [?]. Reading "lubentissime" was intended; the printed form appears to be "lubentiffime".
